headline: Colombia Certifies Consumer Credit Usury Cap at 28.34% Effective Annual for November
summary: Colombia's financial superintendent certified the maximum interest rate ceiling for consumer credit at 28.34% effective annual for November via Resolution 1707 of 2026.
why: Usury limits set by regulators dictate lending margins for commercial banks and consumer finance availability.

impacts.name: Colombian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Interest rate caps restrict the maximum lending yields banks can charge on consumer credit products.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
